title: Combine the parser and renderer proposals
problem_statement: The group needs one compatible interface that preserves normalization and output formatting.
proposed_approach: Keep the parser's normalized input contract and compose it with the renderer through a small explicit pipeline.
alternatives_considered: Replace both with a new shared implementation
tradeoffs: Composition preserves independent contributions but introduces one integration boundary.
unresolved_concerns: Confirm the public function name with the group before integration.
